title: Unfragmenting Nawatl NMT: Single-Variant Specialization for Masewalkopa
abstract: arXiv:2610.22110v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In minoritized (low-resource) language technologies, a common response to data sparsity is to aggregate text across multiple varieties and treat the combined data as a single corpus. However, mixed corpora of closely related indigenous variants can produce an artificial register that is accountable to no single speaker community, a structural failure we call variant fragmentation. This issue is acute for minoritized languages native to Mexico, such as Nawatl. Building on a 70,000-pair multi-variant foundation, we specialize an mT5-large checkpoint to Masewalkopa (nhn), the Nawatl variety spoken in Santa Ana Tlacotenco. We curate 2,665 parallel pairs, reserve all sentence-level data for evaluation, and incorporate 192 elder-transcribed target sentences via asymmetric backtranslation. translated_title: 消除纳瓦特尔语机器翻译的碎片化：面向Masewalkopa变体的单变体专门化
translated_abstract: 在少数化（低资源）语言技术中，应对数据稀疏的常见做法是将多种变体的文本聚合起来，并把合并后的数据当作单一语料库处理。然而，由密切相关的原住民语言变体混合而成的语料库可能产生一种不属于任何单一语言社群的人造语域，我们将这种结构性失败称为“变体碎片化”。这一问题对于源自墨西哥的少数化语言（如纳瓦特尔语/Nawatl）尤为严重。在一个包含7万句对的多种变体基础之上，我们将mT5-large检查点专门化到Masewalkopa（nhn）——即Santa Ana Tlacotenco地区使用的纳瓦特尔语变体。我们整理了2,665个平行句对，将所有句子级数据保留用于评估，并通过非对称回译的方式纳入192个由长者转录的目标语句子。一个自定义的有限状态分析器将未分析的表层形式比例从82.0%降至19.9%，并以纯文本前缀的形式提供功能性句法标签，使得……
tldr: 该论文指出将密切相关原住民语言变体混合训练会造成“变体碎片化”问题，并通过将mT5-large专门化到Santa Ana Tlacotenco的Masewalkopa纳瓦特尔语变体，结合自定义有限状态分析器和基于长者转录数据的非对称回译，显著提升了该单变体的机器翻译性能。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "variant fragmentation" as a structural failure in low-resource NMT and specializes mT5-large to the Masewalkopa (nhn) variety of Nawatl, leveraging a custom finite-state analyzer and asymmetric backtranslation of elder-transcribed sentences to significantly improve single-variant translation quality.
